summary: The registrant, SS Innovations International, Inc., filed a Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 to announce that its subsidiary graduated the first class of a specialized cardiac robotic surgery training course. The press release includes no financial terms, transaction structure, or board recommendation. This is an operational update, not a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring. The filing is a routine current report on business developments. No deal terms or strategic changes are present.
